note.note:
Please provide the following so I can generate the requested Problem List Clinical Note:

- The full transcript of the consult (doctor-patient conversation)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format

Once I have these, I will produce:

Consult Summary:
- Two-line summary of the entire consult.

Problem List:
- Issue 1: brief description with timeline and symptoms; pertinent systems review; social history, meds, exam findings; differential diagnosis from DDx (if consistent with transcript) with likelihood tag and one-line justification.
- Issue 2: same structure as Issue 1.
- Issue 3: same structure as Issue 1.

Medications:
- List medications mentioned (with dose/route/frequency noted as "not documented" if not provided).

Allergies:
- List allergies mentioned.

Past Medical History:
- Relevant PMH as mentioned.

Social History:
- Living situation, smoking, alcohol, etc., as mentioned.

Preventative History:
- Preventive care measures mentioned (screenings, vaccinations, etc.) and any recent preventive visits.

Physical Examination:
- Vitals (if provided) and examination findings.

Plan:
- Actions, tests, treatments, referrals, and follow-up.

Quality checks:
- Note any missing elements, conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark as “conflict noted”), and brief comment on transcript quality if noisy/inaudible.

If you paste the transcript and the DDx, I will produce the structured note exactly per your required headings.
